prompt: Declan coughed softly and (to ask / me / to pour) him some cold water.
explanation_ru: Косвенная просьба в прошедшем времени передаётся по схеме asked + дополнение (me) + инфинитив с to (to pour).

prompt: Since the platform at York can be busy, the clerk (to advise / Kavita / to allow) extra time between trains.
explanation_ru: Когда назван адресат совета (Kavita), после advise обязательно используется инфинитив с частицей to (to allow).

prompt: Dark clouds appeared, so Mum (to tell / Tomasz / to carry) the chairs inside.
explanation_ru: Для передачи распоряжения используется глагол tell в Past Simple с прямым дополнением и инфинитивом с to.

prompt: The school guard warned the children ___ the road near the bend.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном инфинитиве после warn + объект частица not ставится перед to (not to cross); порядок to not и форма don't — частые ошибки.

prompt: We planned a surprise dinner for Ngozi at a small restaurant in Bristol. Even though Lucia hates calling restaurants, I (to persuade / her / to book) a quiet table for six. Omar overheard our chat and (to offer / to bake) her favourite lemon cake himself. Later, the restaurant called back and asked Lucia (anyone / to prefer) vegetarian dishes.
explanation_ru: После persuade нужен объект и to-инфинитив, после offer — сразу to-инфинитив без объекта, а общий косвенный вопрос вводится через if/whether с глаголом в Past Simple.

prompt: Did Claire (to remind / you / to renew) your library card today?
explanation_ru: В вопросе с Did глагол remind стоит в базовой форме, а далее следует дополнение (you) и инфинитив с to (to renew).

prompt: Before handing out the exam papers, the examiner (to instruct / everyone / to write) the date at the top.
explanation_ru: Косвенная инструкция после глагола instruct строится по модели instruct + дополнение (everyone) + to-инфинитив.

prompt: The park keeper warned us to not feed bread to the ducks.
answer: The park keeper warned us not to feed bread to the ducks.
accepted_answers: The park keeper warned us not to feed bread to the ducks.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить частицу not после to (to not feed); в отрицательном инфинитиве правильно not to feed.

prompt: As she picked up her coat, Sinead ___ Diego to lock the back door before leaving the café.
explanation_ru: Только глагол remind сочетается с моделью «объект + to-инфинитив»; употреблять said, explained или suggested перед Diego to lock — частая ошибка.

prompt: The station hall was full of people on Friday evening. Hiroshi phoned Nadia and (to tell / her / to sit) near the ticket machine. He also warned her (not / to buy) tickets from anyone in the street. Five minutes later, he found her right by the benches.
explanation_ru: Утвердительная команда передаётся как told + объект + to-инфинитив, а предупреждение с запретом — как not to + инфинитив.

prompt: Viktor messaged Leila, “Could you phone the local garage before noon about the delivery van, please?” → Viktor asked Leila …
answer: Viktor asked Leila to phone the local garage before noon about the delivery van.
accepted_answers: Viktor asked Leila to phone the local garage before noon about the delivery van.
explanation_ru: Вежливая просьба с Could you ... please? в косвенной речи сокращается до конструкции asked + объект + to-инфинитив без слов please и could.

prompt: Our swimming coach didn't forget anything — he even (to remind / us / to pack) spare goggles for the race in Cardiff.
explanation_ru: Напоминание о действии передаётся через remind + дополнение (us) без предлога + инфинитив с to (to pack).

prompt: Before anyone climbed the wall, the instructor ordered the beginners to read the safety notice carefully.
answer: Before anyone climbed the wall, the instructor ordered the beginners to read the safety notice carefully.
accepted_answers: Before anyone climbed the wall, the instructor ordered the beginners to read the safety notice carefully.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после глагола order правильно употреблено прямое дополнение (the beginners) и инфинитив с частицей to (to read).

prompt: Gareth was unloading boxes outside the school when the caretaker came out and shouted, “Don’t park in front of this gate — the school bus needs the space!” Which sentence reports the caretaker’s words accurately?
options: The caretaker ordered Gareth not to park in front of that gate because the school bus needed the space.
The caretaker asked Gareth whether the school bus had already parked in front of that gate.
The caretaker invited Gareth to park in front of that gate until the school bus arrived.
The caretaker reminded Gareth that he had parked the school bus in front of that gate.
explanation_ru: Запрет Don't park передаётся через ordered + объект + not to park, this меняется на that, а needs сдвигается в прошедшее время needed.

prompt: Stormy weather caused short power cuts across our office in Glasgow. Lin walked past every desk and (to urge / us / to save) our open files before the screens went dark. She also advised Jakub (not / to install) the big update while the lights were still flickering. On her way out, she asked me (I / to own) a spare power cable.
explanation_ru: После urge нужен объект и to-инфинитив, отрицательный совет после advised Jakub требует порядка not to install, а общий вопрос после asked me вводится союзом if/whether с глаголом в Past Simple.

prompt: While Carmen climbed up to paint the high ceiling, she (to beg / Farhan / to hold) the metal ladder firmly so it would not slip on the tiles.
explanation_ru: Глагол beg в прошедшем времени удваивает согласную (begged) и требует модели «дополнение + инфинитив с to».

prompt: Right after we collected our new gym passes, the manager strictly warned ___ the entrance code with anyone outside the club.
explanation_ru: После warn идёт прямое дополнение без предлога to (us) и отрицательный инфинитив not to share; предлог to перед объектом и порядок to not — частые ошибки.

prompt: Calling the ferry office from a noisy street was a terrible idea. Because the traffic roared past, I (to ask / the agent / to speak) much more slowly while she read out the booking code. Hearing the background noise, she kindly (to offer / to email) the full timetable straight to my inbox. Before hanging up, she also asked me (my phone / to receive) text alerts about delays.

blanks.cue: to ask / the agent / to speak

explanation_ru: Просьба строится как ask + объект + to-инфинитив, предложение помощи — как offer + to-инфинитив без объекта, а общий вопрос после asked me требует союза if/whether и сдвига в Past Simple.
